how_l1a2x_reported_it.arithmetic_note: for the two alternative rules the rescaled margin came out numerically equal to the raw margin (to 4e-17 dx) although the rescaling factors are 0.976359 and 0.997184; the recorded field is therefore not a correct quotient of the quantities it names, and it is recomputed here from the sealed margins and displacements rather than trusted
how_l1a2x_reported_it.criticism: the recorded spread was the spread of the *rescaled* margins, that is each rule's margin divided by that rule's own full displacement in primary units; that normalisation is exactly one and divides a genuine difference by the effect it is supposed to measure, so the comparison band of L1A-2x (6.4e-15 dx) understated its own rule disagreement. This stage does not inherit that band and does not use any such rescaling

prespecified_comparison_error_of_this_st.rule: comparison_error = max(raw rule spread, measured walk noise floor, arc/root agreement), all in dx and all measured in this run; the verdict needs margin > dominance factor x comparison_error

rule: the comparison error of L1A-2x is recomputed from its sealed numbers and reported in raw dx; the old stage's payloads are left exactly as they are and no new conclusion is written into them

what_the_spread_is_made_of.note: the spread between the prespecified rules is a genuine, dimensional disagreement: it carries both the difference between sampling the increment at one point and over the support cell, and the difference between the frozen t = 0 coefficient and the local coefficient. It is reported here in dx, unreduced
